actions.workflowPolicyForThisRevision: Pin every referenced action to an exact commit SHA and grant contents:read only.

billingBoundary.actionsUsageEndpoint: unavailable because the active GitHub token lacks the user scope
billingBoundary.authorizedBehavior: Do not change billing, add a payment method, raise a budget, select a paid runner, or retry after any terminal workflow attempt without new user authorization.
billingBoundary.triggerPrerequisite: Before workflow_dispatch, prove at least 30 included Linux minutes and 10 MiB artifact headroom remain, or prove account controls block all paid overage. If neither can be verified, stop for user direction.
billingBoundary.artifactCeiling: The workflow may upload only artifacts/gate0-container-proof/receipt.json. The runner must cap each captured log field at 65,536 UTF-8 bytes and the complete serialized receipt at 1,048,576 bytes; an over-limit receipt must not be uploaded.
